about_the_game:
A kind-hearted succubus, Remuria, an outlier among the succubi, won't kill her prey and cannot ignore injustice. One day, she helps Ariandelle, a half-elf slave, escape captivity. However, Remuria soon discovers that her own village is also in danger.

Teaming up with Ariandelle, the two set out on a journey with shared goals: to free all the enslaved elves, defend the succubi village, and uncover their enemy's ultimate goal. But that's not the end of their struggle, as Ariandelle is afflicted with Soul Crusher—a powerful mental spell that only Remuria can temporarily alleviate with her special powers. To break the spell completely, they must track down the caster.

Experience the game in two separate modes. Enjoy the story in Novel Mode, where you follow the plot and get to know the characters. In RPG Mode you can explore, fight enemies, and work to push the story forward.

Attack enemies first to gain the upper hand with a preemptive strike, giving you an advantage in turn-based battles. Plan ahead to use your resources carefully to overcome tough challenges and keep moving forward.

Animated H-Scenes

Enjoy a hot collection of beautifully animated scenes to enhance your viewing pleasure!

Recollection Room

Nothing is lost in the story! Every unlocked scene can be revisited and watched again through the Recollection Room.

Novel Mode

In this mode, you can enjoy all scenes with a traditional Visual Novel interface and its features, including LOG, SAVE, and HIDE Window.

Merciful Second Chances

Even if you lose a battle, you can continue playing with 1 HP. If you're out of resources, the game allows you to restart from the beginning of the map with your resources rolled back.

Save Anywhere

The game allows you to save anytime you want, so don’t worry about losing your progress.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains mosaic censorship, explicit nudity and sexual relationships between adults.

name: Succubus Crisis

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 7/8/8.1/10
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: In this turn-based RPG, play as Remuria, a kind-hearted succubus, who teams up with the half-elf Ariandelle in their shared goal to save the succubi village and free enslaved elves. It's a tale of tender friendship, personal growth, and passion set in a captivating, dark fantasy world.
supported_languages:
English, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
